data.title: 史尔特尔 · 赤岩礁滩的冰淇淋小憩
data.action: 单脚踩在岩石上，一手拿冰淇淋甜筒轻尝，另一手叉腰侧视
data.location: 烈日灼晒的红色岩礁浅水湾
data.lighting: 正午直射光照亮发梢和树莓冰球，赤岩台阶投下硬边阴影
data.camera: from below, three quarter view, full body
data.description: 正午烈日烤炙的赤色礁石浅湾，海水在热浪下波光粼粼。史尔特尔单脚踏在滚烫的平整岩壁上，一手拿着双球树莓冰淇淋甜筒小心品尝，另一手叉腰。察觉到目光后挑起红瞳冷冷瞥来，嘴里虽抱怨着炎热，手里的甜食却丝毫没有放下的意思。
data.promptProse: Seen from below across the cove, Surtr puts one foot on a low ledge of red sandstone, her free hand planted on her hip. She brings a double scoop of raspberry ice cream to her lips and glances sideways as the breeze catches the end of her red hair. The ledge casts a clean shadow over the tidal shelf in front. Behind her, warm red rock shelves descend into clear blue shallows, with a stripe of bright foam at the mouth of the bay. The sharp midday light picks out the bright piping on her athletic swimwear.
data.animaCaption: She plants one foot on a step of red rock and lifts a raspberry double-scoop cone to her lips, with her free hand on her hip. The rock shelves step down behind her to clear blue water in the cove.
data.nsfwProse: Surtr wears her carbon-black athletic halter bikini, with crossed straps, bright magma-orange piping and small metal buckles.
